message: Thank you so much topher! From being my goto guy to squad leader. I hope you well and nasabi ko naman na sayo lahat. Goodluck and thank you ulit. Chat ka lang pag gusto mo bumabalik haha.

Congrats future Forbes 30 under 30 candidate! Its an honor working along side with one of the best in our team. Thank you for teaching, not only me, but the whole team of your knowledge and experience. You deserve everything that you are getting right now, and you deserve more than you think you are worth. Know that the team wouldn't make it this far without you and your efforts. Always keep the hunger and the obsession to be great and successful. The end goal should always be benz and rolly.
"Do what is right, not what is easy" - R.T.B.

Annyeong Topherrrr! 'twas really great getting to know you and working with you (: Hope we can hang out soon hahaha ingat sa travels mo, and wishing you all the best on your next work journey! I know you'll do great ~
Sir Topher, thank you sa lahat ng guidance at mentorship as our squad lead. Goodluck sa next steps mo.

Hi Topher! Paano na yung monthly updates sa friend niyo? Iniwan mo kami. Char! Hehe. Anyway, kahit limited lang yung collabs natin sa mga events, nakita ko na may malaking potential ka. Sincere ka sa work mo, and maganda rin yung work ethic mo. Gusto nga kitang i-recruit samin haha. Kidding aside, tingin ko you'll have a great future ahead!! Good luck sa new work! Stay healthy, enjoy din and keep in touch, please! Thanks and byiee!

heyaa~ thank you Topher for all your hard work over the years~ isa kang napaka-solid na teammate xD

you've truly become one of the pillars of the team
so many problems felt lighter (or straight up, nonexistent lol) because you were there
I really appreciate how so many aspects of our work could rest easy because you were the one taking care of them
working with you made things smoother and less stressful for all of us
knowing you were on it always gave everyone peace of mind

I just know there's gonna be some sadness sa Adam and Decode now moving forward T T
but everyone has their own path to take, and we fully support you wherever yours leads
we'll always be cheering you on every step of the way

wishing you all the best in everything—career, family, health, wealth, and love life xD
good luck and see you when I see you~

I think nasabi ko naman na during one of our meetings pero good luck pre yun lang haha jk. Grabe, can't believe we're saying goodbye already. From GHP na naging trainer mo pa ata ako (naunahan mo pa lo), to working side by side sa web squad, I'm proud to say na ang layo na ng narating mo. And honestly, salamat kasi ikaw pa yung isa sa mga bumuhat sakin during the Decode and offboarding system transition.

Ang saya lang makita kung gaano ka nag-grow, not just technically, but as a teammate din and as a person.

If you want, I can:
- Make it shorter (Slack/Teams)
- Add inside jokes
- Make it sound more mentor-y
Just tell me the tone 👌

---
Joke di yan GPT heartfelt yan haha.

Deserve mo lahat ng good opportunities coming your way. Good luck and congrats sa next chapter!

Hi Topher,

Thank you not only for your efforts but also for your closeness especially with the rest of the team. Sigurado na yung mga relationships na nabuo within Trend will continue even after. I thank you sa lahat ng blood, sweat and tears na na-pour out mo in doing the deliverables, helping out with solving problems and collaborating with the other members and even having that stint of having to try to lead a Hyperautomation Squad. Walang waste sa efforts na ginugol mo, as lahat dun will be good memories and good learnings rin as well. I wish you all the best sa next journey mo! Keep thriving and growing and keep those who champion you closer. See you around :)

Topher,

We're truly happy for you and excited for what lies ahead on this next chapter of your journey. While it's never easy to say goodbye, it's reassuring to know you're moving toward something new and meaningful.

Your impact at Trend has been undeniable. Through your hard work, passion, and dedication, you've helped shape the team and the company in ways that will last far beyond your time here. What you've built, shared, and contributed will always be part of Trend's story.

At heart, you'll always be a Trender. Your grit, passion, and work ethic are proof that no matter where you go next, you'll continue to grow and prevail. When times get rough, I hope you look back and see just how far you've come, this experience stands as a testament to your perseverance.

Thank you for being not just a great coworker, but a true friend and mentor. It's been an honor working alongside you.

Auf Wiedersehen.

Thank you, Topher! I've witnessed your dedication in everything you do. We've worked on many projects together, and I've always admired how open and welcoming you are to suggestions and ideas. Your collaborative mindset made working with you both easy and enjoyable.

Beyond work, I've also come to know you as someone kind and genuinely curious -- always able to keep conversations going and make people around you feel comfortable. It's been great being able to talk with you not only about work, but also about personal interests and hobbies.

As you begin this new chapter, I wish you nothing but success. I'm confident that you'll thrive and adapt quickly to your new environment. It's inspiring to see you step out of your comfort zone and choose to prioritize yourself and your growth.

Best of luck on your journey, and see you around, Topher!
Hello Sir, thank you po for the guidance you've provided me po through my first year po in Trend. Don't worry po di ko papasabugin Offboarding HAHAHAHA. Congratulations po on your new role!

Hello, Boss Topher! Hindi tayo masyado nag kakilala personally pero salamat sa pagiging friendly and approachable. Especially noong GHP namin, palagi kang nag bibigay ng advices and workarounds sa mga activities and even extending the deadlines. I wish you all the best, good luck sa new opportunity, alam kong hindi ka naman mahihirapan mag adjust interms of workload. Greener Pastures! Ariba! Ariba! Ariba!

Thank you for being a good workmate! Super appreciate ko lahat ng help at guidance mo. Malaki talaga ang contribution mo sa growth ko mula intern hanggang maging senior. Lagi kang nandiyan kapag may tanong ako o kailangan mag-test ng something. Super masipag at maasahan ka bilang co-worker. Medyo masaya ako kasi nagkaroon ako ng project kasama ka. Good luck sa bagong endeavors mo, and stay humble and amazing Sir Topher!

Thank you for being more than just a co-worker – thank you for being a true friend. I hope you don't feel bad about leaving us; I'm genuinely proud of the decision you've made.

This won't be my last message since I'm confident we'll cross paths again. Thank you for all the memories and the brotherhood that made my first job here at Trend so meaningful and exciting. All the challenges we navigated together, the work stress we weathered, and our endless rants about our colleagues – HAHA! You've earned every bit of success coming your way.

Thank you again for everything, and I'm wishing you all the best in your new adventure!
